title: Launch HN: HyperProbe (YC S26) – Agents that do read-only debugging in prod
summary: HyperProbe is a YC S26 startup enabling AI coding agents like Cursor and Claude to safely perform read-only debugging in production by inserting virtual breakpoints to extract exact variable values without risky redeployments.
problem_solved: Eliminates the tedious process of digging through logs/traces or redeploying with debug statements to find production bugs.
why_valuable: It gives AI agents real-time access to live production state, cutting debugging time from hours to minutes while keeping production safe.
